question: The ‘Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana’ (VAMBAY) was launched in which year by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2001**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana' (VAMBAY) was launched in the year **2001** by the Government of India.
 
• It was initiated under the Ministry of Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation.
 
• The scheme aims to provide shelter or upgrade the existing shelter for people living below the poverty line in urban slums.
 
• VAMBAY also focuses on improving the living conditions of slum dwellers by providing better sanitation facilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)**

 
 
• Launched in 2015, it aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor by 2022.
 
• It includes two components: PMAY-U (Urban) and PMAY-G (Gramin) for urban and rural areas, respectively.
 
• The scheme provides interest subsidies on home loans under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).
 
 
 
• **Indira Awaas Yojana (IAY)**
 
 
• Launched in 1985, it focuses on providing housing for the rural poor in India.
 
• Renamed as Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) in 2016.
 
• It aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses.
 
 
 
• **Rajiv Awas Yojana (RAY)**
 
 
• Launched in 2011, it aimed to make India slum-free by encouraging states and union territories to bring all existing slums within the formal system.
 
• Provided property rights to slum dwellers and improved their living conditions.
 
 
 
• **Basic Services to the Urban Poor (BSUP)**
 
 
• Part of the Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission (JNNURM) launched in 2005.
 
• Aimed at providing basic services like water supply, sewerage, and sanitation to the urban poor.
 
• Focused on integrated development of slums through projects for providing shelter, basic services, and other related civic amenities.
